name: 41736-visionprefill-qwen2vl7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one vLLM engine with --distributed-executor-backend uni, i.e. a single worker.
architecture: Qwen2VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, 8.3B params: 32-layer vision tower (embed 1280, patch 14, 2x2 spatial merge) feeding a 28-layer decoder (hidden 3584, 28 query / 4 KV heads, 32768-token window).
load_profile: constant (OPEN loop), rate=36 requests/s, bounded at 1200 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup declared as the first 10%.
workload: Synthetic image-heavy prefill: eight 224x224 gradient JPEGs (quality 85, seeds 100..107) plus a 32-token text prompt per request, one output token, ~579 prompt tokens of which ~94% is picture, temperature 0.0. Declared as eight separate `synthetic_image` sources rather than `images_per_request: 8`, because guidellm 0.7.3 reads a trailing `_<digit>` on a column name as a TURN index and would otherwise emit an eight-turn conversation with one image each.
purpose: An image-understanding assistant describing eight-photo uploads with brief text prompts at 36 requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen2-VL-7B-Instruct

tensor-parallel-size: 1
distributed-executor-backend: uni

max-model-len: 8192
max-num-batched-tokens: 4096
max-num-seqs: 256
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.85
enable-prefix-caching: false

# MUST MATCH scenario.json: eight images per request and no video. It is both the admission limit
# and what the engine's startup profiling pass is sized against.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 8, "video": 0}

compilation-config: {"cudagraph_mm_encoder": true, "encoder_cudagraph_token_budgets": [512, 768, 1024], "encoder_cudagraph_max_vision_items_per_batch": 8}
